entries.en: Elevator, why! Elevator, elevator, elevator, agh!
entries.ro: Liftule, de ce! Lift, lift, lift, agh!

entries.en: Who broke it? Who?! Who broke it?!
entries.ro: Cine l-a stricat? Cine?! Cine l-a stricat?!

entries.en: Up, down, up, down! Elevator can't stay! Has to move!
entries.ro: Sus, jos, sus, jos! Liftul nu stă! Trebuie să se miște!
